name: fastapi
planner_rules:
- Target a FastAPI service: route handlers live in app/routers/, pydantic request/response models in app/models.py, app factory (create_app) in app/main.py.
- Handlers are async only when they await something; otherwise plain def. No blocking calls in async handlers.
- Business logic lives in app/ services/modules, not in handlers: handlers validate, call, and serialize.
- Settings come from environment variables via pydantic-settings; never hard-code secrets or ports.
- Return EXACTLY the fields named in an export's return-shape annotation (serialization tests assert shapes exactly).
- TestClient (starlette) drives API tests: one test class per router, tmp_path or dependency-overrides for storage.
